tasks.label: QMK: Build current target
args: f='${relativeFile}'; case "$f" in keyboards/mini_mighty/kbd/*) kbs='mini_mighty/kbd';; keyboards/mini_mighty/kbd_wireless/*) kbs='mini_mighty/kbd_wireless/rev2';; keyboards/mini_mighty/mouse/*) kbs='mini_mighty/mouse/rev12';; keyboards/mini_mighty/dongle/*) kbs='mini_mighty/dongle';; keyboards/mini_mighty/common/*) kbs='mini_mighty/kbd_wireless/rev2 mini_mighty/mouse/rev12 mini_mighty/dongle';; *) echo "No QMK target for $f" >&2; exit 1;; esac; for kb in $kbs; do echo "> qmk compile -kb $kb -km default"; qmk compile -kb "$kb" -km default || exit $?; done
